Title: [Submission] Next on the list (Red List propagation)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Next on the list
Cardtype: Action modifier/Combat
Only usable when burning a Red List minion in combat or as a  action, or in combat with a Red List minion. Put this card on this minion. This minion can burn this card when burning a Red List minion in combat or as a  action (including during this action) to make another non-titled minion controlled by the same Methuselah Red List.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:

This minion can burn this card when burning a Red List minion in combat or as a  action (including during this action) to make another non-titled minion controlled by the same Methuselah Red List.

I like the idea, but I think the "use it now or hold it for later" element of it is probably making it look a little over-complex. I'd probably just make it happen now instead. Given that there's now no action to block or referendum to fail (etc.), that seems possibly slightly fairer too - I can, at least, annoy your Red Listing efforts fractionally by not transferring out that vampire just yet.

Given that there's now no action to block or referendum to fail (etc.), that seems possibly slightly fairer too - I can, at least, annoy your Red Listing efforts fractionally by not transferring out that vampire just yet.

Well, "now or never" is slightly too situational -- entering combat with a Red List minion takes time, it requires a setup that can take a few turns. Then burning the Red List in combat takes time (the first combat may not work how it was planned). If you have to wait to burn a Red List guy to play the card, it will clog your hand too long.
There's already a restriction about the controller of the next Red List minion, I think it's enough.
